instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot. Inside an unfinished concrete building, the woman in the yellow safety vest and yellow hard hat (R2) stands on the left in profile, facing right. On the right, the woman in the orange safety vest and white hard hat (R1) stands in profile, facing left. They clasp their right hands in a firm handshake between them, smiling and making eye contact. The background features a plain concrete wall and a glass sliding door on the far left. Natural, soft light illuminates the scene, highlighting the bright safety gear against the muted grey surroundings.
elements: R1 is the profile person facing left into the handshake with R2
R2 is the profile person facing right into the handshake with R1
R1 and R2 clasp their right hands in a firm handshake between them
R1 and R2 smile and make eye contact during the handshake
R1 and R2 wear hard hats as safety gear during the interaction
The handshake occurs inside an unfinished concrete building
